cause_quote: The new portable.ts validated the extraction reply against `findings ... { maxItems: 12 }`, `gaps ... { maxItems: 8 }` and `queries ... { maxItems: 4 }` while the extraction prompt stated no limits, so a longer model reply failed validation as a whole.
user_saw: Deep research questions that the model answered in detail ended as partial results with no findings, and idle Control UI sessions showed a Deep research header button plus a full-width bar.
summary: Clamps model reply lists to the schema limits and states them in the prompt instead of rejecting the reply, bounds start/resume tool results, and removes the Deep research header controls so the side panel is the only UI entry point.
reasoning: The defect half (detailed replies rejected, empty partial results) comes from the schema maxItems limits that shipped with the plugin in c50ff4fbe541 (#173964), which created portable.ts with these schemas and the unlimited extraction prompt (blame of the prompt and schema lines points there and the file history starts there). The UI half (removing the header button/bar and inline card) is a product decision layered on newer pane commits; I classed the fix by its defect part, with medium confidence because over-limit replies depend on model behavior.
